worldcombat.skill.stockpile.summary: Store up to three breaths, each with its own defensive bonus. Keep them for Spit Up or Swallow, or use Stockpile while full to spend one for healing or a close shove. Each layer releases only its own defenses when spent or expired.
worldcombat.skill.stockpile.use.0: Store defenses for Spit Up or Swallow
worldcombat.skill.stockpile.use.1: Release one breath for healing while full
worldcombat.skill.stockpile.use.2: Shove close foes while retaining two layers
Each layer raises Defense by %1$s stage and Special Defense by %2$s, up to 3 layers.
Each breath lasts about %1$s; taking damage preserves it.
worldcombat.skill.stockpile.break.mend: Full-store release — Mend: spend one layer to restore up to %1$s of maximum health.
worldcombat.skill.stockpile.break.burst: Full-store release — Shove: spend one layer to push visible nearby foes outward by up to %1$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.stockpile.timing: Self move, range %1$s blocks; after %2$s s of telegraph it costs %4$s PP to fire, then %3$s s recovery and %5$s s cooldown from commit.
worldcombat.skill.stockpile.growth.0: At level %1$s the store lasts %2$s and the cooldown drops to %3$s s.
worldcombat.skill.stockpile.growth.1: At level %1$s the store reaches %2$s and the cooldown drops to %3$s s.
worldcombat.skill.stockpile.preference.b: Use again while full to spend one layer: Mend heals, Shove pushes close foes away. Spit Up and Swallow can still spend all stored layers.
worldcombat.skill.stockpile.preference.a: Consider storing again when a threat is within this distance; larger starts earlier.
A threat closer than this makes the companion fight instead of storing; larger gives up topping up more often up close.
How many layers to stack before pressing in; larger is greedier and engages later, smaller engages on a thinner shell.
Use again at three layers to spend one for healing or a shove against visible nearby foes. Spit Up and Swallow can spend the whole store. Spending, expiry and removal release only these layers’ defensive bonuses.
